items.title: Google and GitHub make Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers and GitHub Copilot
problems: Before says Copilot users could not select Gemini 4 Carbon. The changelog establishes general availability, but does not say whether any users had access before then.

items.title: AWS adds Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed to Amazon Bedrock
